title: God Is Light
short_description: Part one is the most foundational. It is saturated in the identity of God as light and as love: the glory light being, like a man, seated on the throne. Yeshua is the light of the world, and light leads creation into a face-to-face encounter with God.

part_sketch.title: Part sketch
part_sketch.text:
* where should I introduce "shaping", hepta-shaping as part of being in the outline-chain?
 * I'm pretty sure the appropriate way to introduce shaping is in base 3 as a follow up and extension of being. It may be helpful to connect being to choosing a shape; ie. being is shaping, choosing to configure into a shape

questions.question: Should I introduce atonement in PART 1?
questions.answer: Shouldn't introduce atonement in PART 1, because PART 1 is essentially the 'GOD IS LOVE' section? The synonymization of atonement with love in 1 John 4:10 seems to require at least the introduction of the concept _ term ATONEMENT, doesn't it?
